trigger.value: While you have your shield raised, you would take damage from a physical attack.

description.value: You snap your shield in place to ward off a blow. Your shield prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.
